name: Mellbystrand - Båstad station

officialSources.name: Hallandsleden: Mellbystrand - Båstad station
facts: Official name Mellbystrand - Båstad station.
Official distance 12 km.
Difficulty Grön, normalized here as easy.
No official estimated time shown.
Official order is Kusten stage 10 and whole-trail official order 35; this is the final current Kusten section.

Route description starts at historic Strandhotellet in Mellbystrand, follows Laholmsbukten beaches past Mellbystrand and Skummeslövsstrand, passes Skummeslövsbadet, continues through Södra Skummeslöv nature reserve pine forest and residential areas, and ends at Båstad station where Hallandsleden meets Skåneleden.

facts: English page confirms length 12 km and Green difficulty.
English text confirms Båstad station as the Hallandsleden/Skåneleden meeting point.
English route text says Strandhotellet was built in 1927 and Skummeslövsbadet opened in 1961.

officialSources.name: Hallandsleden places API
facts: Tokenized query with limit=100 returned 49 official place records.
Server-side placeCategory filters tried during research did not filter the result set, so import selection must classify and filter records by name, coordinates and route proximity.

Core on-route or endpoint records include Strandhotellet, Hotell Hallandsgården, Mellbystrand bus stop, multiple beach toilets, Skummeslövsstrand/Skummeslövsbryggan, Skummeslöv services, Allarp toilet, Båstad station stop and Båstad station toilet.
The official feed also includes far side records around Hökafältet, Hemmeslövsstrand, Malen and Båstad town/harbour that should be suppressed or modeled only as side-service metadata.

officialSources.name: Länsstyrelsen Halland: Södra Skummeslöv
facts: Södra Skummeslöv is a Laholm nature reserve, 113 ha, protected since 1972 and expanded in 2014.
Main-thread overlay found the official route inside the reserve for approximately km 7.301-8.546.
Rules include no fires, no tent/caravan/camper setup 24:00-06:00, no loose dogs, and on open sand heath a dog leash may not exceed 2 m due birdlife.
Visitor/currentness text says Laholm municipality is decommissioning the Allarp/Hemmeslöv treatment plant and pump station on the strandheden; no route closure was found.
Länsstyrelsen 2026-03-19 news lists Södra Skummeslöv among planned 2026 nature-conservation burns, weather-dependent.

officialSources.name: Laholm sea-bathing/beach rules
facts: Bathing season is 1 May-15 September.
During bathing season dogs may be on ordinary beaches only 18:00-08:00 and must be leashed; Kattvägen dog beach is the exception.
Camping/overnighting on beaches with tent, camper or caravan is prohibited; camping is only allowed at campsites.
Horse use on beaches is allowed outside bathing season; local information says horses are not allowed on the beach 1 May-15 September.
Motor traffic on the beach has been prohibited since 2024-05-31.
Hallandstrafiken bus line 225 is described as running along the coast, with stops such as Birger Pers väg, Kolonivägen and Stora Strandvägen.

officialSources.name: Skåneleden: Båstad tågstation connector
facts: Official Skåneleden connector page describes Båstad tågstation as a 2.6 km green/one-hour Skåneleden connection.
Use as terminal-context evidence at Båstad station, not as K10 geometry.

notes: Direct route span through Södra Skummeslöv was found by overlay against the official GPX.
No fires.
No tent/caravan/camper setup 24:00-06:00.
No loose dogs; on open sand heath leash may not exceed 2 m due birdlife.
No damage to live/dead trees/shrubs and no picking/collecting plants except berries, edible mushrooms and single specimens.
No motor vehicle use/parking outside designated road/place.
No kitesurf/kite flying/similar bird-disturbing craft 1 March-15 July.
No model aircraft, water skiing, personal watercraft, ultralight aircraft or other activities disturbing visitors/scaring birds.
Max 3 knots in marked water area.
Riding only on designated trail and cycling only on road/designated cycle route.
Main-thread overlay found no official K10 GPX points inside Norra Skummeslöv/Skummeslövs sanddynsreservat Norra; treat as nearby side context only.
Hökafältet is north/behind the K10 start and belongs better to K9/shared Mellbystrand context.
Bathing season is 1 May-15 September.
During bathing season dogs may be on ordinary beaches only 18:00-08:00 and must be leashed; Kattvägen dog beach is the exception.
Camping/overnighting on beaches with tent/camper/caravan is prohibited.
Horses are not allowed on beaches 1 May-15 September.
Motor traffic on the beach has been prohibited since 2024-05-31.
No K10-specific official closure/reroute was found.
Södra Skummeslöv is listed among planned 2026 conservation burns, weather-dependent; treat as temporary smoke/access disturbance risk, not a durable closure.
Laholm municipality street-light modernization starts in Mellbystrand and continues south toward Skummeslöv/Skottorp April-October 2026; treat as urban/road-area work caution.
2025-07-08 Laholm pier news reports sand drifting over access/rescue road near the Mellbystrand bathing pier; start-area sand-drift/access caution only.
Recheck Brandrisk/MSB/municipal fire bans and official Hallandsleden deviation page before import/publication.
Route is dominated by sandy beach/dune corridor, pine forest in Södra Skummeslöv, residential streets and station approach.
Laholmsbukten is shallow but Länsstyrelsen warns of strong currents and sudden seabed changes on windy days.
Soft sand and water accumulation can affect adjacent local routes after rain; do not treat as a K10 closure without stronger evidence.
